name: DeteQt Diamond-on-Silicon Chip Platform

specs.sensitivity: ~100 pT/sqrt(Hz) in scanning mode; best lab NV: 9.4 pT/sqrt(Hz) (Tokyo Tech 2024)
specs.form_factor: chip-scale, scanning probe or contact mode

cost.system: not publicly stated; comparable R&D systems ~$100k-300k
cost.diamond_sample: Element Six NV ensemble: ~$500-2,000 for small sample

deployment: Commercialized for biological cell imaging with 100 nm spatial resolution. Single-neuron magnetic imaging capability demonstrated (not whole-brain).
bci_relevance: NV-diamond enables single-neuron magnetic imaging impossible for OPM or SQUID (spatial resolution advantage). Sensitivity (pT not fT) limits to peripheral nerve / MCG, not MEG. For independent researcher: DIY NV-diamond bench setup ~$15-20k achieves ~10-50 pT/sqrt(Hz) — viable for magnetomyography, not MEG.
